plainTranslation: Their Neptune in your 4th house: they dissolve the boundaries of your private world - dreamy, merging, sometimes confusing about where home even is. Failure mode: idealizing the domestic life, or losing yourself in it. Stay grounded about what home actually is.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
